<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?><record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><access>package_private</access><active>true</active><api_name>x_pd_integration.PagerDutyRenotifyTestKit</api_name><caller_access/><client_callable>false</client_callable><description>Helpers for the PD: Renotify ATF tests (optional tests package of the Renotify overlay)</description><mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable><name>PagerDutyRenotifyTestKit</name><sandbox_callable>false</sandbox_callable><script>/*** Changes made to this script are not supported by PagerDuty ***/
/**
 * Helpers for the "PD: Renotify ..." ATF tests (the optional tests package of the Renotify overlay).
 *
 * world() builds a PagerDutyRenotify wired to a fake PagerDuty and a fake clock, so a test can drive a whole run - replies,
 * timeouts, loops - in a few lines without PagerDuty, the network or waiting. Runs are real rows of
 * x_pd_integration_renotify_run, so the table, the columns and the JSON the run is saved as are tested too. Everything a world
 * created is removed by cleanup().
 *
 * machine() plays the executor over the pure state machine only (PagerDutyRenotifyMachine), without any record.
 */
var PagerDutyRenotifyTestKit = Class.create();
PagerDutyRenotifyTestKit.prototype = {
  type: 'PagerDutyRenotifyTestKit',

  MINUTE: 60000,
  TABLE: 'x_pd_integration_renotify_run',

  initialize: function () {},

  /** An on-call entry like PagerDuty's GET /oncalls returns it. */
  oncall: function (level, userId) {
    return { escalation_level: level, user: { id: userId } };
  },

  /** An incident.responder.replied v3 webhook payload. */
  replyEvent: function (pdIncidentId, userId, state, occurredAtMs) {
    return {
      event_type: 'incident.responder.replied',
      occurred_at: new Date(occurredAtMs).toISOString(),
      data: { type: 'incident_responder', incident: { id: pdIncidentId }, user: { id: userId }, state: state }
    };
  },

  /** An incident.resolved v3 webhook payload. */
  resolvedEvent: function (pdIncidentId) {
    return { event_type: 'incident.resolved', data: { id: pdIncidentId } };
  },

  /**
   * Plays the executor over the pure state machine: resolves each level when it is reached, records the responder
   * requests, and keeps its own clock in minutes.
   * @param {Object} policy PagerDuty escalation policy ({ num_loops, escalation_rules: [{ escalation_delay_in_minutes }] })
   * @param {Function} oncallsFor function (level) returning the on-calls at that moment
   */
  machine: function (policy, oncallsFor) {
    var machine = new x_pd_integration.PagerDutyRenotifyMachine();
    var built = machine.buildRules(policy);
    var minute = this.MINUTE;
    var requests = [];
    var now = 0;
    var run;
    var api = {};
    var execute = function (actions) {
      actions.forEach(function (action) {
        if (action.type === 'requestResponders') {
          requests.push({ atMin: now / minute, userIds: action.userIds });
        } else if (action.type === 'resolveLevel') {
          execute(machine.onLevelResolved(run, machine.usersForLevel(oncallsFor(action.level), action.level), now).actions);
        }
      });
    };
    api.requests = requests;
    api.run = function () { return run; };
    api.start = function () {
      var started = machine.start({ incidentId: 'I', policyId: 'P', requesterId: 'R', rules: built.rules, numLoops: built.numLoops }, now);
      run = started.run;
      execute(started.actions);
      return api;
    };
    api.at = function (minutes) { now = minutes * minute; return api; };
    api.reply = function (userId, status, repliedAtMin) {
      execute(machine.onReply(run, userId, status, now, repliedAtMin === undefined ? undefined : repliedAtMin * minute).actions);
      return api;
    };
    api.tick = function () { execute(machine.onTick(run, now).actions); return api; };
    api.alreadyAsked = function (askedAtMinByUser) {
      var asked = {};
      Object.keys(askedAtMinByUser).forEach(function (id) { asked[id] = askedAtMinByUser[id] * minute; });
      machine.onAlreadyAsked(run, asked);
      return api;
    };
    api.resolveIncident = function () { machine.onIncidentStatus(run, 'resolved'); return api; };
    api.users = function () { return requests.map(function (r) { return r.userIds; }); };
    return api;
  },

  /**
   * A PagerDutyRenotify on a fake PagerDuty with a fake clock.
   * @param {Object} [options] policyDelays (minutes per level, default [15, 15, 15]), numLoops, oncalls (default A, B, C on
   *   levels 1-3), requester (the PagerDuty user clicking Renotify), defaultUser (the user asked on behalf of that person)
   */
  world: function (options) {
    var kit = this;
    var opts = options || {};
    var id = 'ATF' + new Date().getTime() + Math.floor(Math.random() * 100000);
    var delays = opts.policyDelays || [15, 15, 15];
    var createdRuns = [];

    var pd = {
      incidentId: id + 'I',
      policy: {
        id: id + 'P',
        name: 'ATF policy',
        num_loops: opts.numLoops || 0,
        escalation_rules: delays.map(function (d) { return { escalation_delay_in_minutes: d }; })
      },
      oncalls: opts.oncalls || [kit.oncall(1, 'A'), kit.oncall(2, 'B'), kit.oncall(3, 'C')],
      incidentResponders: [], // as GET /incidents/{id} reports them: { user: { id }, state, requested_at }
      requests: [],           // what was asked of PagerDuty: { users, requester, from }
      postFails: false,
      oncallsStatus: 0,       // set to an HTTP status to make the on-calls request fail with it
      incidentFails: false
    };

    var response = function (status, body) {
      return { getStatusCode: function () { return status; }, haveError: function () { return status >= 400; }, getErrorMessage: function () { return 'HTTP ' + status; }, getBody: function () { return JSON.stringify(body); } };
    };
    var FakeRest = function () {};
    FakeRest.prototype = {
      hasError: function () { return false; },
      getError: function () { return ''; },
      getREST: function (feature) {
        // Like the platform's REST client, a raw '[' or ']' is "Invalid query"
        if (/[\[\]]/.test(feature)) { return response(400, { error: 'Invalid query' }); }
        var route = feature.split('?')[0];
        if (route === 'escalation_policies/' + pd.policy.id) { return response(200, { escalation_policy: pd.policy }); }
        if (route === 'incidents/' + pd.incidentId) {
          if (pd.incidentFails) { return response(500, { error: 'boom' }); }
          return response(200, { incident: { id: pd.incidentId, incidents_responders: pd.incidentResponders } });
        }
        if (route === 'oncalls') {
          if (pd.oncallsStatus) { return response(pd.oncallsStatus, { error: 'refused' }); }
          return feature.indexOf('escalation_policy_ids%5B%5D=' + pd.policy.id) >= 0
            ? response(200, { oncalls: pd.oncalls, more: false })
            : response(200, { oncalls: [], more: false });
        }
        return response(404, {});
      },
      postREST: function (feature, body, from) {
        if (pd.postFails) { return response(500, { error: 'boom' }); }
        pd.requests.push({
          users: body.responder_request_targets.map(function (t) { return t.responder_request_target.id; }),
          requester: body.requester_id,
          from: from
        });
        return response(200, {});
      }
    };

    var requester = opts.requester || 'REQ';
    var queued = [];
    var clock = new Date().getTime();
    var svc = new x_pd_integration.PagerDutyRenotify({
      rest: function () { return new FakeRest(); },
      pd: function () {
        return {
          getUserIDFromFieldData: function (snUserId) { return snUserId === 'atf-user' ? requester : null; },
          getUserEmailByPDID: function (pdUserId) { return pdUserId.toLowerCase() + '@example.com'; }
        };
      },
      defaultUser: opts.defaultUser !== undefined ? opts.defaultUser : 'DEFAULT',
      incident: function (snIncidentSysId) { return snIncidentSysId === 'atf-incident' ? pd.incidentId : null; },
      queue: function (runRecord) { queued.push(runRecord.getUniqueValue()); }
    });
    svc._now = function () { return clock; };

    var world = { pd: pd, svc: svc, SN_INCIDENT: 'atf-incident', SN_USER: 'atf-user', requester: requester };
    world.now = function () { return clock; };
    world.advance = function (minutes) { clock += minutes * kit.MINUTE; return world; };
    world.start = function () {
      var started = svc.start(world.SN_INCIDENT, pd.policy.id, world.SN_USER);
      createdRuns.push(started.runId);
      return started;
    };
    world.reply = function (userId, state, offsetMs) {
      svc.handleReplyEvent(kit.replyEvent(pd.incidentId, userId, state, clock + (offsetMs === undefined ? 1000 : offsetMs)));
      return world;
    };
    world.resolve = function () { svc.handleResolvedEvent(kit.resolvedEvent(pd.incidentId)); return world; };
    world.tick = function () { svc.tick(pd.incidentId); return world; };
    /** Runs the work the executor queued as events (what the Script Action does). */
    world.flushQueued = function () {
      while (queued.length) { svc.flush(queued.shift()); }
      return world;
    };
    world.queuedCount = function () { return queued.length; };
    world.run = function (runId) {
      var gr = new GlideRecord(kit.TABLE);
      if (runId) {
        gr.get(runId);
      } else {
        gr.addQuery('pd_incident_id', pd.incidentId);
        gr.orderByDesc('sys_created_on');
        gr.setLimit(1);
        gr.query();
        gr.next();
      }
      return gr;
    };
    world.requestedUsers = function () { return pd.requests.map(function (r) { return r.users.slice().sort(); }); };
    world.cleanup = function () {
      var gr = new GlideRecord(kit.TABLE);
      gr.addQuery('pd_incident_id', pd.incidentId);
      gr.query();
      while (gr.next()) { gr.deleteRecord(); }
    };
    return world;
  }
};
</script><sys_class_name>sys_script_include</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>PagerDuty_Renotify_v1.0.0</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-10-09 12:00:00</sys_created_on><sys_id>7666e0505885c513f6743c8b99c07bd6</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>PagerDutyRenotifyTestKit</sys_name><sys_package display_value="PagerDuty Incident Resolution Platform" source="x_pd_integration">39a9d9664f834e00dd657bb28110c77b</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="PagerDuty Incident Resolution Platform">39a9d9664f834e00dd657bb28110c77b</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_include_7666e0505885c513f6743c8b99c07bd6</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>PagerDuty_Renotify_v1.0.0</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-10-09 12:00:00</sys_updated_on></sys_script_include></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?><record_update table="sys_atf_test"><sys_atf_test action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><active>true</active><copied_from/><description>The decision logic only (no records): which level is asked when, and what a join, a decline or a stale reply does.

Checks that:
- starts at level 1 and requests only that level
- a join stops the run and requests nothing else, however long it waits
- a decline requests the next level immediately
- a cancelled request counts as a decline
- a level with two people waits until both decline, and stops when either joins
- ignores a reply from someone who is not on the current level
- ignores a reply that predates the request it would answer
- starts over whatever happened before: asks A, then B, then C even though A had declined earlier</description><enable_parameterized_testing>false</enable_parameterized_testing><fail_on_server_error>true</fail_on_server_error><name>PD: Renotify machine - levels, joins and declines</name><parameters/><remember/><sn_atf_tg_generated>false</sn_atf_tg_generated><sys_class_name>sys_atf_test</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>PagerDuty_Renotify_v1.0.0</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-10-09 12:00:00</sys_created_on><sys_id>a99823efdc2c7de58feaa73fe3f11af5</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>PD: Renotify machine - levels, joins and declines</sys_name><sys_package display_value="PagerDuty Incident Resolution Platform" source="x_pd_integration">39a9d9664f834e00dd657bb28110c77b</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="PagerDuty Incident Resolution Platform">39a9d9664f834e00dd657bb28110c77b</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_atf_test_a99823efdc2c7de58feaa73fe3f11af5</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>PagerDuty_Renotify_v1.0.0</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-10-09 12:00:00</sys_updated_on></sys_atf_test><sys_variable_value action="delete_multiple" query="document_key=a99823efdc2c7de58feaa73fe3f11af5"/></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?><record_update table="sys_atf_test"><sys_atf_test action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><active>true</active><copied_from/><description>The decision logic only: level delays, the policy's loops, exhaustion, shift changes, and when a level counts as due.

Checks that:
- moves on only after the level delay
- repeats the levels for the policy's loops and then is exhausted: 3 levels x (1 + 3 loops) = 12 requests
- a policy with no rules is exhausted at once
- resolves the people on call when each level is reached, so a shift change counts
- skips a level with nobody on call
- stops when the incident is resolved
- counts a level as due when its delay expired, not when the timer noticed
- counts a level as due when PagerDuty stamped the decline, unless that is missing or in the future</description><enable_parameterized_testing>false</enable_parameterized_testing><fail_on_server_error>true</fail_on_server_error><name>PD: Renotify machine - timeouts, loops and the end</name><parameters/><remember/><sn_atf_tg_generated>false</sn_atf_tg_generated><sys_class_name>sys_atf_test</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>PagerDuty_Renotify_v1.0.0</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-10-09 12:00:00</sys_created_on><sys_id>b85f7b5dde019a7dbea5676b1d0f7837</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>PD: Renotify machine - timeouts, loops and the end</sys_name><sys_package display_value="PagerDuty Incident Resolution Platform" source="x_pd_integration">39a9d9664f834e00dd657bb28110c77b</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="PagerDuty Incident Resolution Platform">39a9d9664f834e00dd657bb28110c77b</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_atf_test_b85f7b5dde019a7dbea5676b1d0f7837</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>PagerDuty_Renotify_v1.0.0</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-10-09 12:00:00</sys_updated_on></sys_atf_test><sys_variable_value action="delete_multiple" query="document_key=b85f7b5dde019a7dbea5676b1d0f7837"/></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?><record_update table="sys_atf_test"><sys_atf_test action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><active>true</active><copied_from/><description>PagerDuty failures, Stop, and renotifying one person.

Checks that:
- a PagerDuty failure on start is reported and the run is marked failed
- when PagerDuty refuses the on-calls request, the failure points at the oncalls.read OAuth scope
- other on-calls failures do not mention the scope
- a failure on a later level marks the run failed and stops it
- cancel stops an active run and nothing more is requested
- cancel of a run that has already ended changes nothing
- renotifying one person requests just them, as the user who clicked, and starts no run
- renotifying yourself is requested on behalf of another user, because PagerDuty ignores a request you make of yourself
- renotifying one person needs a person, and checks what start checks
- renotifying one person reports a PagerDuty failure</description><enable_parameterized_testing>false</enable_parameterized_testing><fail_on_server_error>true</fail_on_server_error><name>PD: Renotify run - failures, stopping and single people</name><parameters/><remember/><sn_atf_tg_generated>false</sn_atf_tg_generated><sys_class_name>sys_atf_test</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>PagerDuty_Renotify_v1.0.0</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-10-09 12:00:00</sys_created_on><sys_id>b07336c17f154b33bfac6446d5fb66b1</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>PD: Renotify run - failures, stopping and single people</sys_name><sys_package display_value="PagerDuty Incident Resolution Platform" source="x_pd_integration">39a9d9664f834e00dd657bb28110c77b</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="PagerDuty Incident Resolution Platform">39a9d9664f834e00dd657bb28110c77b</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_atf_test_b07336c17f154b33bfac6446d5fb66b1</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>PagerDuty_Renotify_v1.0.0</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-10-09 12:00:00</sys_updated_on></sys_atf_test><sys_variable_value action="delete_multiple" query="document_key=b07336c17f154b33bfac6446d5fb66b1"/></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?><record_update table="sys_atf_test"><sys_atf_test action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><active>true</active><copied_from/><description>Not asking again someone PagerDuty has just asked, while still waiting for their answer.

Checks that:
- does not ask again someone PagerDuty asked itself just as the level became due, but still waits for their answer
- asks someone whose pending request is older than the moment the level became due
- asks again someone PagerDuty asked before the click: that is what Renotify is for
- skips only the people already asked in a level with several
- asks someone who has already answered
- uses the moment the delay expired, not when the timer noticed, when a level times out
- asks everyone when PagerDuty cannot be read
- never skips the one-off renotify of a person</description><enable_parameterized_testing>false</enable_parameterized_testing><fail_on_server_error>true</fail_on_server_error><name>PD: Renotify run - people PagerDuty already asked</name><parameters/><remember/><sn_atf_tg_generated>false</sn_atf_tg_generated><sys_class_name>sys_atf_test</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>PagerDuty_Renotify_v1.0.0</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-10-09 12:00:00</sys_created_on><sys_id>0643812e00e135cdb00a609d51503677</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>PD: Renotify run - people PagerDuty already asked</sys_name><sys_package display_value="PagerDuty Incident Resolution Platform" source="x_pd_integration">39a9d9664f834e00dd657bb28110c77b</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="PagerDuty Incident Resolution Platform">39a9d9664f834e00dd657bb28110c77b</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_atf_test_0643812e00e135cdb00a609d51503677</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>PagerDuty_Renotify_v1.0.0</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-10-09 12:00:00</sys_updated_on></sys_atf_test><sys_variable_value action="delete_multiple" query="document_key=0643812e00e135cdb00a609d51503677"/></record_update>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?><record_update table="sys_atf_test"><sys_atf_test action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><active>true</active><copied_from/><description>A run in the real table: declines, duplicate deliveries, joins, the level delay, loops, exhaustion, resolution and recovery.

Checks that:
- a decline queues the follow-up, and running it requests level 2 once
- a duplicate delivery of the same webhook does not request level 2 twice
- two people on a level replying before the follow-up runs still advance exactly once
- a join stops the run and nothing more is ever requested
- ignores a reply that predates the request it would answer
- moves to the next level only after the level's delay has passed
- resolves the people on call when the level is reached (a shift change)
- a run that times out on its last level is saved as exhausted and stops being active
- repeats the policy for its loops before it is exhausted
- a tick that changes nothing does not rewrite the run
- the incident being resolved ends the run
- purges finished runs after the retention period, never an active run or a young one
- a tick recovers a run left waiting after a follow-up that claimed its work and died</description><enable_parameterized_testing>false</enable_parameterized_testing><fail_on_server_error>true</fail_on_server_error><name>PD: Renotify run - replies, timeouts and the end</name><parameters/><remember/><sn_atf_tg_generated>false</sn_atf_tg_generated><sys_class_name>sys_atf_test</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>PagerDuty_Renotify_v1.0.0</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-10-09 12:00:00</sys_created_on><sys_id>4d386c8db5d8b0e3805312a9d3202f13</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>PD: Renotify run - replies, timeouts and the end</sys_name><sys_package display_value="PagerDuty Incident Resolution Platform" source="x_pd_integration">39a9d9664f834e00dd657bb28110c77b</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="PagerDuty Incident Resolution Platform">39a9d9664f834e00dd657bb28110c77b</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_atf_test_4d386c8db5d8b0e3805312a9d3202f13</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>PagerDuty_Renotify_v1.0.0</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-10-09 12:00:00</sys_updated_on></sys_atf_test><sys_variable_value action="delete_multiple" query="document_key=4d386c8db5d8b0e3805312a9d3202f13"/></record_update>

    var kit = new x_pd_integration.PagerDutyRenotifyTestKit();
    var world;
    var thrown = function (fn) {
      try { fn(); } catch (e) { return String(e.message || e); }
      return '';
    };

    describe('Renotify run: failures, stopping and single people', function () {
      beforeEach(function () { world = kit.world(); });
      afterEach(function () { world.cleanup(); });

      it('a PagerDuty failure on start is reported and the run is marked failed', function () {
        world.pd.postFails = true;
        expect(thrown(function () { world.start(); })).not.toBe('');
        var run = world.run();
        expect(run.getValue('state')).toBe('failed');
        expect(run.getValue('active')).toBe('0');
        expect(run.getValue('last_error')).toBeTruthy();
      });

      it('when PagerDuty refuses the on-calls request, the failure points at the oncalls.read OAuth scope', function () {
        world.pd.oncallsStatus = 403;
        expect(thrown(function () { world.start(); })).toContain('oncalls.read');
        expect(world.run().getValue('state')).toBe('failed');
        expect(world.run().getValue('last_error')).toContain('oncalls.read');
        expect(world.pd.requests.length).toBe(0);
      });

      it('other on-calls failures do not mention the scope', function () {
        world.pd.oncallsStatus = 500;
        var message = thrown(function () { world.start(); });
        expect(message).toContain('Could not fetch on-calls');
        expect(message).not.toContain('oncalls.read');
      });

      it('a failure on a later level marks the run failed and stops it', function () {
        world.start();
        world.pd.postFails = true;
        world.reply('A', 'declined');
        world.flushQueued();
        expect(world.run().getValue('state')).toBe('failed');
        world.pd.postFails = false;
        world.advance(60).tick();
        expect(world.pd.requests.length).toBe(1);
      });

      it('cancel stops an active run and nothing more is requested', function () {
        world.start();
        var id = world.run().getUniqueValue();
        world.svc.cancel(id);
        expect(world.run().getValue('state')).toBe('cancelled');
        expect(world.run().getValue('active')).toBe('0');
        world.advance(60).tick();
        expect(world.pd.requests.length).toBe(1);
      });

      it('cancel of a run that has already ended changes nothing', function () {
        world.start();
        world.reply('A', 'joined');
        world.svc.cancel(world.run().getUniqueValue());
        expect(world.run().getValue('state')).toBe('joined');
      });

      it('renotifying one person requests just them, as the user who clicked, and starts no run', function () {
        world.svc.renotifyUser(world.SN_INCIDENT, 'U9', world.SN_USER);
        expect(world.pd.requests).toEqual([{ users: ['U9'], requester: 'REQ', from: 'req@example.com' }]);
        expect(world.run().isValidRecord()).toBe(false);
      });

      it('renotifying yourself is requested on behalf of another user, because PagerDuty ignores a request you make of yourself', function () {
        world.svc.renotifyUser(world.SN_INCIDENT, 'REQ', world.SN_USER);
        expect(world.pd.requests).toEqual([{ users: ['REQ'], requester: 'DEFAULT', from: 'default@example.com' }]);
      });

      it('renotifying one person needs a person, and checks what start checks', function () {
        expect(thrown(function () { world.svc.renotifyUser(world.SN_INCIDENT, '', world.SN_USER); })).toContain('choose a responder');
        expect(thrown(function () { world.svc.renotifyUser('no-such-incident', 'U9', world.SN_USER); })).toContain('out of context');
        expect(thrown(function () { world.svc.renotifyUser(world.SN_INCIDENT, 'U9', 'nobody'); })).toContain('not mapped');
      });

      it('renotifying one person reports a PagerDuty failure', function () {
        world.pd.postFails = true;
        expect(thrown(function () { world.svc.renotifyUser(world.SN_INCIDENT, 'U9', world.SN_USER); })).not.toBe('');
      });
    });
})(outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual);

    var kit = new x_pd_integration.PagerDutyRenotifyTestKit();
    var world;
    var inserted;

    // Inserts a row the way the inbound webhook handling does, which is what the Business Rule listens to
    var receive = function (payload) {
      var row = new GlideRecord('x_pd_integration_webhook_import');
      row.initialize();
      row.setValue('message_type', payload.event_type);
      row.setValue('payload', typeof payload === 'string' ? payload : JSON.stringify(payload));
      var id = row.insert();
      if (id) { inserted.push(id); }
      return id;
    };

    describe('Renotify webhook: the Business Rule feeds the run', function () {
      beforeEach(function () {
        inserted = [];
        world = kit.world();
        world.start();
      });
      afterEach(function () {
        world.cleanup();
        inserted.forEach(function (id) {
          var row = new GlideRecord('x_pd_integration_webhook_import');
          if (row.get(id)) { row.deleteRecord(); }
        });
      });

      it('a responder joining ends the run', function () {
        expect(receive(kit.replyEvent(world.pd.incidentId, 'A', 'joined', world.now() + 1000))).toBeTruthy();
        expect(world.run().getValue('state')).toBe('joined');
        expect(world.run().getValue('active')).toBe('0');
      });

      it('the incident being resolved ends the run', function () {
        receive(kit.resolvedEvent(world.pd.incidentId));
        expect(world.run().getValue('state')).toBe('resolved');
      });

      it('a reply about another incident leaves the run alone', function () {
        receive(kit.replyEvent(world.pd.incidentId + 'X', 'A', 'joined', world.now() + 1000));
        expect(world.run().getValue('state')).toBe('active');
      });

        expect(r.requests.length).toBe(12);

        expect(r.run().loop).toBe(3);
        expect(r.requests[3].userIds).toEqual(['A']);

        var r = kit.machine(policy([]), function () { return []; }).start();
        expect(r.run().state).toBe('exhausted');

    var kit = new x_pd_integration.PagerDutyRenotifyTestKit();
    var world;

    describe('Renotify run: replies, timeouts and the end', function () {
      beforeEach(function () { world = kit.world(); });
      afterEach(function () { world.cleanup(); });

      it('a decline queues the follow-up, and running it requests level 2 once', function () {
        world.start();
        world.reply('A', 'declined');
        expect(world.queuedCount()).toBe(1);
        world.flushQueued().flushQueued();
        expect(world.requestedUsers()).toEqual([['A'], ['B']]);
        expect(world.run().getValue('level')).toBe('2');
      });

      it('a duplicate delivery of the same webhook does not request level 2 twice', function () {
        world.start();
        world.reply('A', 'declined').reply('A', 'declined');
        world.flushQueued();
        expect(world.requestedUsers()).toEqual([['A'], ['B']]);
      });

      it('two people on a level replying before the follow-up runs still advance exactly once', function () {
        world.pd.oncalls = [kit.oncall(1, 'A1'), kit.oncall(1, 'A2'), kit.oncall(2, 'B')];
        world.start();
        world.reply('A1', 'declined', 1000).reply('A2', 'declined', 1500);
        world.flushQueued();
        expect(world.requestedUsers()).toEqual([['A1', 'A2'], ['B']]);
      });

      it('a join stops the run and nothing more is ever requested', function () {
        world.start();
        world.reply('A', 'joined');
        expect(world.queuedCount()).toBe(0);
        expect(world.run().getValue('state')).toBe('joined');
        expect(world.run().getValue('active')).toBe('0');
        world.advance(60).tick();
        expect(world.pd.requests.length).toBe(1);
      });

      it('ignores a reply that predates the request it would answer', function () {
        world.start();
        world.advance(1);
        world.reply('A', 'joined', -600000);
        expect(world.run().getValue('state')).toBe('active');
      });

      it('moves to the next level only after the level\'s delay has passed', function () {
        world.start();
        world.advance(14).tick();
        expect(world.pd.requests.length).toBe(1);
        world.advance(1).tick();
        expect(world.requestedUsers()).toEqual([['A'], ['B']]);
      });

      it('resolves the people on call when the level is reached (a shift change)', function () {
        world.start();
        world.pd.oncalls = [kit.oncall(1, 'A'), kit.oncall(2, 'NEW'), kit.oncall(3, 'C')];
        world.advance(15).tick();
        expect(world.requestedUsers()).toEqual([['A'], ['NEW']]);
      });

      it('a run that times out on its last level is saved as exhausted and stops being active', function () {
        world.start();
        world.advance(15).tick();
        world.advance(15).tick();
        world.advance(15).tick();
        expect(world.run().getValue('state')).toBe('exhausted');
        expect(world.run().getValue('active')).toBe('0');
        expect(world.requestedUsers()).toEqual([['A'], ['B'], ['C']]);
        world.advance(60).tick();
        expect(world.pd.requests.length).toBe(3);
      });

      it('repeats the policy for its loops before it is exhausted', function () {
        world = kit.world({ policyDelays: [1, 1], numLoops: 1, oncalls: [kit.oncall(1, 'A'), kit.oncall(2, 'B')] });
        world.start();
        for (var i = 0; i < 3; i++) { world.advance(1).tick(); }
        expect(world.run().getValue('state')).toBe('active');
        expect(world.run().getValue('loop')).toBe('1');
        world.advance(1).tick();
        expect(world.run().getValue('state')).toBe('exhausted');
        expect(world.requestedUsers()).toEqual([['A'], ['B'], ['A'], ['B']]);
      });

      it('a tick that changes nothing does not rewrite the run', function () {
        world.start();
        var before = world.run().getValue('sys_updated_on');
        world.advance(1).tick();
        expect(world.run().getValue('sys_updated_on')).toBe(before);
      });

      it('the incident being resolved ends the run', function () {
        world.start();
        world.resolve();
        expect(world.run().getValue('state')).toBe('resolved');
        expect(world.run().getValue('active')).toBe('0');
        world.advance(60).tick();
        expect(world.pd.requests.length).toBe(1);
      });

      it('purges finished runs after the retention period, never an active run or a young one', function () {
        world.start();
        var days = function (n) { return n * 24 * 60; };
        world.advance(days(40));
        expect(world.svc.purgeFinishedRuns(30, world.pd.incidentId)).toBe(0);   // still active
        expect(world.run().isValidRecord()).toBe(true);
        world.reply('A', 'joined');
        expect(world.svc.purgeFinishedRuns(60, world.pd.incidentId)).toBe(0);   // changed only moments before the fake "now"... but within 60 days
        expect(world.svc.purgeFinishedRuns(0, world.pd.incidentId)).toBe(0);    // 0 keeps everything
        expect(world.run().isValidRecord()).toBe(true);
        expect(world.svc.purgeFinishedRuns(30, world.pd.incidentId)).toBe(1);   // 40 days on, past 30
        expect(world.run().isValidRecord()).toBe(false);
      });

      it('a tick recovers a run left waiting after a follow-up that claimed its work and died', function () {
        world.start();
        world.reply('A', 'declined');
        var stuck = world.run();
        stuck.setValue('pending_actions', '');
        stuck.update();
        world.tick();
        expect(world.requestedUsers()).toEqual([['A'], ['B']]);
      });
    });
})(outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual);

jasmine.getEnv().execute();

    var kit = new x_pd_integration.PagerDutyRenotifyTestKit();
    var policy = function (delays) {
      return { num_loops: 0, escalation_rules: delays.map(function (d) { return { escalation_delay_in_minutes: d }; }) };
    };
    var two = function () {
      return kit.machine(policy([15, 15]), function (level) { return [kit.oncall(level, level === 1 ? 'A' : 'B')]; });
    };

    describe('Renotify machine: people PagerDuty already asked', function () {
      it('counts their answer from the moment PagerDuty asked them, not from when the level was requested', function () {
        var r = two().start().at(1).reply('A', 'declined', 1).alreadyAsked({ B: 0.5 });
        r.at(2).reply('B', 'joined', 0.8);
        expect(r.run().state).toBe('joined');
      });

      it('still ignores an answer from before PagerDuty asked them', function () {
        var r = two().start().at(1).reply('A', 'declined', 1).alreadyAsked({ B: 0.5 });
        r.at(2).reply('B', 'joined', 0.2);
        expect(r.run().state).toBe('active');
      });

      it('only knows people of the current level, and leaves the rest on the level\'s own request time', function () {
        var r = kit.machine(policy([15, 15]), function (level) {
          return level === 1 ? [kit.oncall(1, 'A')] : [kit.oncall(2, 'B1'), kit.oncall(2, 'B2')];
        }).start().at(1).reply('A', 'declined', 1).alreadyAsked({ B1: 0.5, ZZ: 0 });
        expect(r.run().askedAt).toEqual({ B1: 0.5 * kit.MINUTE });
        r.at(2).reply('B2', 'joined', 0.8);
        expect(r.run().state).toBe('active');
      });

      it('forgets who was asked when the next level starts', function () {
        var r = kit.machine(policy([15, 15, 15]), function (level) { return [kit.oncall(level, ['A', 'B', 'C'][level - 1])]; })
          .start().at(1).reply('A', 'declined', 1).alreadyAsked({ B: 0.5 });
        expect(r.run().askedAt).toEqual({ B: 0.5 * kit.MINUTE });
        r.at(2).reply('B', 'declined', 2);
        expect(r.run().askedAt).toEqual({});
      });
    });
})(outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual);

    var kit = new x_pd_integration.PagerDutyRenotifyTestKit();
    var world;

    // Someone PagerDuty has asked itself, as GET /incidents/{id} reports them
    var asked = function (userId, atMs, state) {
      return { user: { id: userId }, state: state || 'pending', requested_at: new Date(atMs).toISOString() };
    };

    describe('Renotify run: people PagerDuty already asked', function () {
      beforeEach(function () { world = kit.world(); });
      afterEach(function () { world.cleanup(); });

      it('does not ask again someone PagerDuty asked itself just as the level became due, but still waits for their answer', function () {
        world.start();
        var declinedAt = world.now() + 1000;
        world.pd.incidentResponders = [asked('B', declinedAt)];
        world.advance(0.2);
        world.svc.handleReplyEvent(kit.replyEvent(world.pd.incidentId, 'A', 'declined', declinedAt));
        world.flushQueued();
        expect(world.requestedUsers()).toEqual([['A']]);
        expect(world.run().getValue('level')).toBe('2');
        world.svc.handleReplyEvent(kit.replyEvent(world.pd.incidentId, 'B', 'joined', declinedAt + 5000));
        expect(world.run().getValue('state')).toBe('joined');
      });

      it('asks someone whose pending request is older than the moment the level became due', function () {
        world.start();
        world.pd.incidentResponders = [asked('B', world.now() - 600000)];
        world.reply('A', 'declined');
        world.flushQueued();
        expect(world.requestedUsers()).toEqual([['A'], ['B']]);
      });

      it('asks again someone PagerDuty asked before the click: that is what Renotify is for', function () {
        world.pd.incidentResponders = [asked('A', world.now() - 30000)];
        world.start();
        expect(world.requestedUsers()).toEqual([['A']]);
      });

      it('skips only the people already asked in a level with several', function () {
        world.pd.oncalls = [kit.oncall(1, 'A'), kit.oncall(2, 'B1'), kit.oncall(2, 'B2')];
        world.start();
        world.pd.incidentResponders = [asked('B1', world.now() + 1000)];
        world.reply('A', 'declined');
        world.flushQueued();
        expect(world.requestedUsers()).toEqual([['A'], ['B2']]);
        expect(Object.keys(JSON.parse(world.run().getValue('run_json')).responses).sort()).toEqual(['B1', 'B2']);
      });

      it('asks someone who has already answered', function () {
        world.start();
        world.pd.incidentResponders = [asked('B', world.now() + 1000, 'declined')];
        world.reply('A', 'declined');
        world.flushQueued();
        expect(world.requestedUsers()).toEqual([['A'], ['B']]);
      });

      it('uses the moment the delay expired, not when the timer noticed, when a level times out', function () {
        world.start();
        world.advance(16);
        world.pd.incidentResponders = [asked('B', world.now() - 60000 + 500)];
        world.tick();
        expect(world.requestedUsers()).toEqual([['A']]);
      });

      it('asks everyone when PagerDuty cannot be read', function () {
        world.start();
        world.pd.incidentFails = true;
        world.pd.incidentResponders = [asked('B', world.now() + 1000)];
        world.reply('A', 'declined');
        world.flushQueued();
        expect(world.requestedUsers()).toEqual([['A'], ['B']]);
      });

      it('never skips the one-off renotify of a person', function () {
        world.pd.incidentResponders = [asked('U9', world.now() + 1000)];
        world.svc.renotifyUser(world.SN_INCIDENT, 'U9', world.SN_USER);
        expect(world.requestedUsers()).toEqual([['U9']]);
      });
    });
})(outputs, steps, params, stepResult, assertEqual);
